_comment: Places the spawn picker offers, in list order. Ids are county_plan.txt place ids; the picker takes x and z from the plan and leaves out any id the plan doesn't have. danger runs 1 (low) to 5 (extreme).

places.name: Downtown
places.zombies: Part of the 20,000 on the island
places.wake: An office floor, a hotel room or a flat above a shop
places.loot: The best, if you live to carry it out
places.note: The heart of the island: the tallest towers in the county, the elevated railway overhead, and the densest horde anywhere.

places.name: Financial District
places.zombies: Part of the 20,000 on the island
places.wake: An office floor or a hotel room
places.loot: Banks, offices, a few gun safes
places.note: Bank towers, the stock exchange and glass plazas on the south of the island, with the railway threading between them.

places.name: Old Harbor
places.zombies: Part of the 20,000 on the island
places.wake: A warehouse loft or a flat above a bar
places.note: The old brick waterfront: warehouse lofts, wharves, the customs house and the ferry pier.

places.name: Midtown
places.wake: A hotel room or an office
places.note: Mid-rise offices, hotels, a convention centre and the theatre row, where the interstates meet.

places.name: Uptown
places.loot: The hospital, the university, big stores
places.note: Apartment towers, department stores, St. Mary’s Medical Center and the university.

places.name: Eastside
places.note: The docklands: tenements, dockside bars, a seamen’s mission and the union hall against the Megaport fence.

places.name: Riverside
places.wake: A house or a flat above a shop
places.note: An old mill city on the Calder, with a brick downtown, a courthouse, a hospital and the railway bridge.

places.name: Ashby
places.wake: A house or a flat above a shop
places.note: The inland county seat: a compact downtown, Ashby General Hospital, the sheriff’s office and the high school.

places.name: Westgate
places.note: Row houses, corner stores and churches on a tight grid along the river.

places.name: Northside
places.note: Brick walk-ups and the old car plant, with laundromats and diners on every corner.

places.name: Southport
places.note: Workers’ row houses between the rail yards and the docks.

places.name: Pinecrest Estates
places.loot: Garages, basements, the odd gun cabinet
places.note: Cul-de-sacs and big lawns off the beltway, north of the wall.

places.name: Ashby Heights
places.note: Newer estates on the hill east of Ashby.

places.name: Shady Acres
places.note: A trailer park by the beltway, under the airport flight path.

places.name: Seabright
places.wake: A motel room or a house
places.note: A beach town with motels, surf shops, ice-cream parlours and a main street running down to the sand.

places.name: Kingsbridge
places.note: A commuter town south of the airport, with a courthouse square, a mall and a high school.

places.name: Millbrook
places.note: A mill town below the dam, with a textile mill, rows of workers’ houses and a lumber yard.

places.name: Fairview
places.wake: A farmhouse or a house in town
places.note: The farm valley’s town, with a feed store, a grain elevator, a livestock auction and a fairground.

places.name: Cape Merrow
places.note: A fishing village on the cape, with boat sheds, net lofts, a chapel and a bait shop.

places.name: Gull Harbor
places.note: A fishing harbour with trawlers, a cannery and a breakwater.

places.name: Hollow Creek
places.note: A creekside hamlet with a covered bridge, a church and a general store.

places.name: Dunmore
places.note: A crossroads at the foot of the mountains, with a church, a gas station and a grain elevator.

places.name: Timberline
places.note: A logging hamlet deep in the mountains, with a sawmill and a ranger station.
